Note: Please refer to the following before installing the solution:

• Review the solution Release Notes

• There may be known issues pertaining to this Solution, please refer to them before installing.

Candidate multi-instance Codeless Connector Framework implementation for Semperis Lightning. It deploys one group of REST API pollers per Semperis connection and writes to dedicated LightningV2 custom tables, so it can run alongside the legacy Semperis Lightning Function App solution with no schema overlap.
